paite: Paul, Pathian deihlam a Khrist Jesu sawltak leh i unaupa Timothi in, Korinth a Pathian saptuam omte kiang leh Akhaia gam tengteng a misiangthou omte kiang ah:
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist' Pa leh Pathian, zahngaihnate' Pa leh khamuanna tengteng Pathian phat in om hen.
heading: Kipahthu Genna

paite: Pathian in koumau hon khamuanna ngei in gimthuakna peuhmah a omte leng ka khamuan sam theihna ding un, ama'n ka gimthuaknate uah ahon khamuan hi.
Khrist thuaknate tampitak ka tan bang un, Khrist ziak in khamuanna leng tamsem ka tang uhi.
Himahleh gimthuak a ka om uleh noumau khamuanna ding leh hotdamna ding ahi a; huan khamuan a ka om uleh ka thuak bang uh na thuak chiang ua na theih ua na khamuanna ding uh ahi.
Huan gimthuakna tang samte na hih bang un, khamuanna tang samte leng na hi uh chih ka theih un, noute a ka lametna uh akip ahi.
Unaute aw, Asia gam a ka tung ua gimthuakna tung na theih louh uh ka deih kei uhi, huchi a nakpitak a thuakzoh vual louh leh hin leng lamethuai lou khop hial in delhden in ka om uhi.
Ahi, si dia thupukkhum in ka om ua; huai tuh koumau kimuang lou a misite kaithoupa Pathian ka muan zawkna ding uh ahi.
Ama'n huchibang sih lauhuai lak ah hon hunkheta a, ahon hunkhe lellel a, hon hunkhe nawn lai ding ahi, chi in amah ka muang uhi.
Noute'n leng thumna in na hon panpih ding uh ahi, huchi in tampite thumna dawnna vualzawlna piak a ka om chiang un koute ziak in mi tampi in kipahthu agen ding uhi.

Koute suanpen hiai ahi, sapilna ah hilou in, Pathian hehpihna ah hi zaw in sianthouna leh Pathian dikna nei in khovel ah mawltak a ka gamta in, nou lam ah ka gamta hoih nawn sem uh chih ka sia-le-pha theihna un hon theisak hi.
heading: Paul Zinna Ding Kikhelna

paite: Na sim theih uleh na theihtheih ding uh lou ngal thudang himhim na kiang uah ka gelh kei uhi; atawp pha in ka thu uh na theihsiam uh ka lamen lai uhi.
Theihsiamna tan na neih tak bang un, i Toupa Jesu ni chiang in, noute ka hon suan theih bang un nou leng koute na hon suang thei sam ding uhi.
Huan huai gintakna nei in, na kiang uah hong masa leng ka chi a, kipahna thuah nih na neihtheihna ding un.
Noumau tawn kawm in Masidonia gam ah pai zel leng la, Masidonia gam a kipan na kiang uah hong kihei nawn in, Judia gam a ka hohna ding ah noumau hong kha le uchin ka chi ahi.
Huchibang ka ngaihtuah lai in ka lungsim kiplouhdan langsak in hia ka hih? Ahihkeileh, "Ahi, chih leh Ahi kei," chi tuaktuak ding in, thilhih ka tup nak pen sadan in hia ka tup?
Himahleh Pathian amuanhuai bang in noumau lam a ka thu uh, Ahi, chih leh Ahi kei, chih ahi kei hi.
Akoi abang hi hen aw, Pathian Tapa Jesu Khrist thu, kei Silvanas leh Timothi in na lak ua ka gen un, "Ahi leh Ahi kei,” chih ahi sam kei a, amah ah zaw thil tengteng, "Ahi," chih ahi gige hi.
Pathian thuchiamte tengteng in amah ah, "Ahi," chih amu vek hi. Huaiziak in ahi Pathian thupina ding a amah ziak a, "Amen," ka chih uh.
Huan Khrist a noumau toh hon hihkippa leh koute hon thaunilhpa, Pathian ahi.
Amah zaw hon chiamtehpa leh i lungtang a khamna Kha hon pepa leng ahi.
Himahleh ka kha tung a theihpih ding in Pathian ka sam ahi, noumau hon hawi ding in ahi Korinth a ka hong tak louh zawk.
Na ginna uh hon thuneihkhum hilou in, na kipahna ding ua nou toh semkhawm ka hi zaw uhi; ginna a na dinkip ziak un.
